nodes.title: ASK Zia on Website
nodes.summary: On www.zxbank.asia, ASK Zia gives real-time answers, helps locate branches and ATMs, provides product information, handles secure requests (statements, balance checks, blocking lost cards) and product comparisons, all 24/7.

nodes.title: ASK Zia on WhatsApp
nodes.summary: On WhatsApp, users can start a chat with the official number by saying 'Hello Zia' and then check balances, mini statements, transfers, bill payments, receive bill reminders, get spending insights, and chat in English, Hindi, Sinhala, Bengali, or Nepali.

nodes.title: Safe & Private
nodes.summary: ASK Zia uses end-to-end encryption and secure authentication and never asks for sensitive details such as PIN or passwords; all actions comply with ZX Bank privacy and security policies.

nodes.title: How to Use
nodes.summary: Zia is used on the website via the chat icon on www.zxvia.asia, or on WhatsApp by saving the official number and starting with 'Hello Zia'.

children.title: **On Website**
children.summary: Open www.zxvia.asia, look for the Zia chat icon, and start typing questions for instant responses.

children.title: **On WhatsApp**
children.summary: Save the official WhatsApp number (+91-XXX-XXX-XXXX), send 'Hello Zia', and follow the prompts tot access banking features.

nodes.title: Why Ask Zia?
nodes.summary: Advantages of ASK Zia: no queues or waiting, simple answers to complex questions, personalized friendly multilingual support, available anywhere in South Asia.
